_comment: Release bands per the founder's R1→R5 trajectory. Each band has a semver mapping + status + (when applicable) achieved date/tag. The Architecture & Roadmap UI tab consumes this directly.

bands.label: v0.0.1 — pre-R1 substrate
bands.description: All 16 A-tier modules shipped + most B-tier substrate code committed. Engine not yet exercised end-to-end on real LLM.

bands.label: R1 — internal R&D substrate validated
bands.description: First real LLM cycle proven across 4 code paths: architect researcher, pre_dev pipeline, customer-flow E2E, dev cycle with Phase 8-B parallel topology. Total spend $4.79. Substrate fully validated.

bands.label: R1+ — real-use hardening
bands.description: Bug fixes from R1 cycles + small polish (dev_graph project-naming fix, Cost Panel rollup mismatch, etc.). Substrate already proven; this band cleans up rough edges before R2 push.

bands.label: R2 — limited use (founder + early collaborators build real apps)
bands.description: You and early collaborators use the factory to build at least one real (non-toy) application end-to-end. Surfaces real-world gaps that R3-R5 address. Substrate dependencies: 19-C per-customer prefs + React customer dashboard + password auth + real Courier backends.

bands.label: R3 — multi-tenancy + admin auth + real Courier
bands.description: Phase 22 admin auth (founder + role checks) + per-tenant isolation hardening + real Slack/SMTP/GitHub Courier backends with rotated credentials. First step toward acceptable external surface.

bands.label: R4 — Stripe billing + retention + GDPR
bands.description: Phase 20-B Stripe live + S3/R2 retention + nightly backup operational + GDPR cron + per-tenant cost visibility for customers. Customer can self-serve billing.

bands.label: R5 — public-portal ready
bands.description: External pen test passed + final security hardening + public-portal positioning (like Replit). Cycle 3+4 patterns from runbook fully wired. Sign-up flow + onboarding + docs polished. Multi-host eventual (deferred from R3 if single-VM holds).
